notes.title: The Tunnels Are Open
notes.content:
Dive down for the hardest Wastenauts content yet. The Tunnels are now open in the playtest!

[h2]The Tunnels
[/h2]Deep beneath the ground, large groups of Scavs have sought refuge in networks of connected sewer and utility tunnels. Societies have banded together, clans have formed. But something is happening, and the residents are fleeing in droves. Whatever has taken up residence down there isn’t going to leave willingly.

Access to the Tunnels requires beating the Dunes on Story Mode. The recommended level is 7, but try it out at 3. I dare you.

The Tunnels includes several new monsters, new event cards, a new pool of event cards for adventure mode, a new boss, and several new mechanics. NEW NEW NEW Y’ALL.

[h2]New Keyword: Disrupt
[/h2]Disrupt forces a monster to change its currently queued up action. Whenever you disrupt a monster, it’s action list advances to the next action immediately (or loops back around if it’s at the end). It might be obvious, but disrupt doesn’t do anything to monsters that only have one action.

Right now, this new keyword can be found on Disruption Bits, which will add this effect to your attack card. But we’ll be adding it throughout the game as development continues!

[h2]New Keyword: Silence
[/h2]Silence is a negative status that can be applied to characters. It prevents the use of all ability cards - particularly nasty for characters like Jack and Delilah. Each stack of silence ticks down after a turn, so when a monster casts Silence[3] you won’t be able to use ability cards for 3 turns. 

[h2]New Keyword: Panic
[/h2]Panic is a status designed to amplify the negative effects of Out After Dark. When a character is panicked, they cannot end their turn if they have any draws remaining. This is particularly nasty for Andrea trying to stack Grab & Go, or weak parties trying to avoid an upcoming tough fight.

This keyword isn’t removed until you make it back to camp. To be clear, that means if you stay Out After Dark, you’ll still be panicked the next day.

[h2]New Keyword: Flip
[/h2]Flip causes the card to….flip over. Wait, there’s something on the back of those cards??

notes.title: Kickstarter, Playtest Sign-Ups, Name Change!
notes.content:
Ahoy Divers!

We have a TON of news for you today, let's naut waste time with introductory paragraphs.

[h2]New Name, Who Dis?[/h2]
Say hello to Wastenauts, our new name! Along with our rebranding, the official Announcement Trailer is now live on the store page. Plus, checkout the new website at [url=http://www.playwastenauts.com]playwastenauts.com[/url]. There you'll find links to the Discord, Official Wiki, Merch Store and more. 

To celebrate, we've released our official announcement trailer on the Steam page. It includes some previews of things not yet available in the alpha, don't miss it!

We are a tiny, tiny team and still searching all over the internet to find where we used our old name - if you stumble on it, let us know!

[h2]Coming Soon to Kickstarter[/h2]
Our Kickstarter campaign for Wastenauts will be live at the end of March, but you can set a reminder! Head to our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/razburygames/wastenauts]coming soon page[/url] and click to be notified of when we go live. The Kickstarter campaign will offer a ton of exclusive rewards, including in-game skins and irl swag. 

The alpha will be completely open during the Kickstarter - whether you back us or not. But if you're anxious to get a head start...

[h2]Sign Up to Playtest[/h2]
Steam has granted us access to a new feature right on the game page. We've got a new button that will add you to our playtest queue. Click it, and we'll be getting you a key to join the alpha soon. We anticipate starting to roll out keys in the next few weeks, with an alpha starting March 23. The queue is processed first-in first-out, so sign up ASAP!

notes.title: August Closed Alpha Week - Now Live
notes.content:
From Rust is currently in closed alpha, with events about once every three weeks or so. To join our alpha events, find us on Discord, and keep your eyes peeled here for more information!

[h1]What's New In This Alpha[/h1]

[h2]Discord Integration[/h2]
Creating a custom game will now post the game name, zone, and mode to #lfg in our Discord! Hopefully this will help in finding new players to join your game. This option can be disabled in the map menu.

[h2]Mission Rewards[/h2][list]
[*] Adventure Mode now rewards you with 3 cards instead of 1.
[*] Crowns rewarded in all modes has been reduced by 90%.
[*] Popups in the victory panel now display the crowns you’ve won and cards you’ve unlocked before you reach XP assignment. 
[*] Most monsters can now be dropped from both the Wastes and Dunes; updated drop and purchase information is available in the catalogue[/list]

[h2]New Cards[/h2][list]
[*] Blaze of Glory (Lucky Jack Ability)
[*] Saw You Coming (Buster Ability)
[*] Equalizer (Lena Gear)
[*] Polysynth Soundtable (Lena Gear)
[*] Laced Syringes (Lucky Jack Gear)
[*] Electric Pole You Thought Was Unpowered (Event Card)
[*] Cultist (Monster Card)
[*] 1945 Huddson Commandant Sedan (Monster Card)
[*] Mask Bandit (Monster Card)[/list]

[h2]Specific Cards[/h2]
[h3]Behemoth[/h3][list]
[*] HP formula changed from 15 + (15L) to 20 + (10L). As a result, Behemoth HP remains the same at level 1, and is nerfed at higher levels[/list]

[h3]Booby-Trapped Weather Sensor[/h3][list]
[*] HP increased from 7 to 8
[*] Level increased from 2 to 3[/list]

[h3]M.A.G.N.E.T.O.[/h3][list]
[*] HP increased from 7 to 9[/list]

[h3]Rock’em[/h3][list]
[*] HP increased from 4 to 5[/list]

[h3]Sand Skimmer[/h3][list]
[*] HP increased from 2+L to 3+L[/list]

[h3]Scav Warmonger[/h3][list]
[*]Starting HP increased from 1 to 3[/list]

[h3]Shrapnel Whirlwind[/h3][list]
[*] Base HP formula changed from 5 + (5L) to 15+(5L). 
[*] HP gain from scrap remaining in the deck is now +L per scrap card (so, e.g., at level 4, +4HP per scrap card remaining)[/list]

[h3]Sock’em[/h3][list]
[*] HP increased from 6 to 7[/list]

[h3]Strong Gust of Screws and Nails[/h3][list]
[*] Requirement to avoid damage has been increased from more than 1 EP to more than L EP, where L is the level of the zone. 
[*] Now correctly applies its effect if there are multiple characters in the party[/list]

[h2]Store[/h2][list]
[*] The price of all monsters in the store has been rebalanced[/list]
In addition to all new monsters added during this patch, the following monsters have been added to the store: [list]
[*]Claw Worm
[*]M.A.G.N.E.T.O.
[*]Pressure Plates
[*]Rockem
[*]Screaming Scav
[*]Sockem[/list]

[h2]UI[/h2]
Monsters now display their level in the top right corner. Note that for “core” monsters that scale depending on the Adventure Mode level set, the field is blank in the catalog (currently the only place you can view core monsters outside of a session)

[h2]Bugs and Misc[/h2][list]
[*]The “Temp Art” on gear cards is now consistent
[*]Delilah’s abilities now use her silhouette as temp art
[*]Characters are no longer redistributed when a player disconnects after the boss fight; this is mostly to prevent the annoying popup that comes up when you’re trying to assign XP
[*]Fixed a bug where having Delilah in the party would cause the XP assignment window to crash
[*]Fixed a bug where rapidly toggling between the Monster and Character tabs in adventure mode loadout could confuse the game
[*]Performance improvements throughout (including to resource card destruction at camp! finally!)[/list]

notes.title: July Closed Alpha Week
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38238530/be0d69490e0a9c0b4766e83864c01e470d62cd80.png[/img]

From Rust is currently in closed alpha, with events about once every three weeks or so. To join our alpha events, find us on Discord, and keep your eyes peeled here for more information!

[h1]What's New In This Alpha[/h1]
[h2]Art[/h2]
[list]
[*]Card art has been added for Super Scav Party
[*]Card art has been added for Screaming Scav Delilah
[/list]

[h2]Delilah[/h2]
[list]
[*]New Character => Delilah: Delilah is now available to unlock in the store, currently for 500 Crowns. While we anticipate unlocking additional characters by progressing the story, we’re not there yet, and want to take this opportunity to test her out. Delilah has a unique passive which gives her two automatically equipped ability cards (Hunker Down and Grapple) instead of an attack card. 10 new cards have been added for Delilah. Descriptions and ways to obtain them are in the catalog menu.

[*]New Ability Card => Hunker Down
[*]New Ability Card => Grapple
[*]New Ability Card => Fresh Meat
[*]New Ability Card => Wait For Me
[*]New Ability Card => The Old One-Two
[*]New Ability Card => Reckless Swing
[*]New Gear Card => Spike Strips
[*]New Gear Card => Shock Strips
[*]New Gear Card => Lard-Covered Arm Guards
[*]New Gear Card => Ham Hocks

[*]Because she does not have an attack card, Delilah cannot use Bits of any kind
[/list]
[h2]Dialogue[/h2]
[list]
[*]Story mode dialogue in the Wastes has been updated to account for the 4 characters currently playing; some dialogues will not trigger and others have been modified accordingly
[*]Story mode dialogue in the Dunes has been updated to account for the 4 characters currently playing; some dialogues will not trigger and others have been modified accordingly
[/list]
[h2]Specific Card Changes[/h2]
[h3]Rusted Bit:[/h3]
[list]
[*]“+1 Damage” now stacks correctly when you use more than one
[/list]
[h3]Backup Singer:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed the description to remove the icon and keyword for Roll Long; the functionality remains unchanged
[/list]
[h3]Popup Tent:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Deploy Tent now correctly gives 2x EP instead of setting your EP to 1
[/list]
[h3]Escaped Scav:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Event text has been edited to clarify that you will not stay out after dark if you kill the scav
[*]Now gives a Medgoop Dispenser instead of a medkit
[/list]
[h3]Build-a-Bomb Kit:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Now gives an appropriately leveled bomb if you already have 5 stacks of Grab & Go when it’s first crafted
[*]Fixed an issue where Lvl 2 could uncraft itself
[*]Fixed an issue where Lvl 2 could trigger infinitely on the same 5 stacks of Grab & Go
[/list]
[h2]Store[/h2]
[list]
[*]Scav Diviner, Land Mine, Scrapper, and Crackler have been removed from the store
[*]Delilah specific gear cards in the store cannot be purchased until Delilah herself has been unlocked
[/list]
[h2]Bugs & Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improvements to UI animations on title screen
[*]Improvements to carousel behavior
[*]Retaliate now correctly resolves after a monster’s attack is fully complete; this is primarily to address a bug where Dodge and Retaliate would not interact correctly
[*]Story Mode should now only reward monsters the first time it’s completed
[/list]
